description: Call it first in a session, then list_matrices and get_agenda; read before you write. Who you act as and what you may do. Returns: the organization, the member behind this connection and their role, the role this connection actually has (capped by the API token permissions or the OAuth scopes, and by the plan), the plan with its limits and usage (and whether they are enforced), and for each active matrix whether you may edit it. An API token acts as the admin who created it: what it writes is recorded under that member.
name: whoami
